title: Book One · Chapter 97: The Winter Window
story:
During the winter break, Ronan's school shoes stand under his bed.

He does not need to put them on in a hurry. He lies awake and looks at the pale window. His breath makes a small warm place under the blanket.

Mum is already up. She has three small sewing jobs to finish. Soon her customers will leave for family visits. Dad is at Mr Sun's. Ronan has a holiday. Mum and Dad still have work to do.

He dresses slowly and folds the blanket. The fold is crooked. He tries again because no bell is telling him to run.

After breakfast, Mum gives him a little free table space. He brought his school folder home for the break. The class boats stayed in a high cupboard at school.

He opens the first page. The grey clay marks are still on it. He looks at the word floats in his old writing. The letters are uneven, with long lines below them. He smiles at the uneven letters.

He reads the sentence alone. Mum does not help with that line. Then he reads the next. A word still stops him on the third page.

“Underneath,” Mum says when he shows it.

“I saw that before.”

“Yes.”

“I forgot.”

“Now you found it again.”

She goes back to the small coat on her lap. Ronan writes the word on a scrap. He puts it beside his picture. He does not copy the whole page. He wants to build something too.

He takes Bo's two sticks and some folded paper. He draws a blue river with his pencil. Then he builds a low bridge across it. The paper feet bend. He adds a second fold. The bridge stays up under one button.

Mum asks for the button back. It belongs to the little coat.

“Your passenger belongs on my coat,” she says.

He gives it to her and uses a small stone instead. The bridge falls. Both things fit on his fingertip. But the stone is heavier than the button.

He draws the two things beside each other. He can see the sizes of both things. But the heavier stone makes the bridge fall.

At noon, Mrs Lan calls from the front room. Her door is stuck against a rolled cloth. She asks Ronan to move the cloth from his side. He moves the cloth, then rolls it more tightly. It is a smaller roll now. Mrs Lan can put it away.

“Holiday helper,” she says.

“Only until lunch.”

“Then I was just in time.”

After lunch he is restless. Mum cannot take him out yet. He helps clear the table. “There is nothing to do,” he says.

She looks at the sticks and folder on the table. The paper river and bridge are there too.

“Nothing to do?” she asks. “Who made all these things?”

He laughs and starts to put the things away. Now there is space to move. “May I stand at the gate and look for Leo?” he asks.

Leo is away with his family for several days. Ronan knows this. Ronan looks at the road. Leo is still away.

When Dad comes home, they take a short walk before dark. Ronan tells him about the button and the stone. Dad asks about the bridge feet. Tomorrow Ronan will try wider ones. Dad walks beside him, and Ronan holds his warm hand. He is glad they could come out together.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- winter break＝寒假
- restless＝坐不住的
- tightly＝紧紧地
- just in time＝正好赶上

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：clay＝黏土；crooked＝歪的；fingertip＝指尖。

## 读句提示

**I saw that before.**

我／以前见过／它。that指那个难读的词，使用简单过去时。

## 理解问题

1. 寒假里父母为什么仍然工作？
2. 按钮换成小石头后，桥的结果说明了什么？
